requirements.text: DELETE /api/v1/sessions/{session_id} for an owned active session returns HTTP 204 and invalidates the session.

test_cases.title: Delete an owned active sesion
preconditions: Session SES-200 is active and owned by the caller.

steps.expected_result: HTTP 204 is returned and session SES-200 is invalidated.
